valor: For 14 years, a documentary filmmaker follows five Colombian families facing the inequalities of a country where origins shape opportunity. Their decisions, frustrations, resilience and achievements reveal that, although the rules are not the same for everyone, the will to change one's own destiny persists.

THE GAME OF LIFE is an intimate portrait of social mobility, dignity, and hope in Colombia.
